theorem_title: A mechanical quarter certificate at every positive odd count
natural_language_statement:
For $s\in\mathbb N$, define $M(0)=0$, $M(s+1)=3M(s)+2^{\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor}$, and $e(s)=\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor+1$.

For every $s\in\mathbb N$ with $s\ge1$,

$$
4M(s)\le s2^{e(s)}.
$$

This numerical certificate supplies the hypothesis for the actual-orbit quarter-gap result.
